traditions.KJV: that they should not eat of the most holy things ,

65.english_reference: till there stood [ up ] a priest with Urim and Thummim .

traditions.WLC: עַ֛ד עֲמֹ֥ד הַ כֹּהֵ֖ן לְ אוּרִ֥ים וְ תוּמִּֽים

traditions.KJV: forty and two thousand three hundred and threescore ,

traditions.KJV: Beside their manservants and their maidservants ,

67.english_reference: of whom [ there were ] seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven :

traditions.WLC: אֵ֔לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וְ שִׁבְעָ֑ה
traditions.KJV: of whom [ there were ] seven thousand three hundred thirty and seven :

traditions.KJV: and they had two hundred forty and five singing men and singing women .

68.english_reference: [ Their ] camels , four hundred thirty and five :

traditions.WLC: גְּמַלִּ֕ים אַרְבַּ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים וַ חֲמִשָּׁ֑ה
traditions.KJV: [ Their ] camels , four hundred thirty and five :

68.english_reference: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses .

traditions.WLC: חֲמֹרִ֕ים שֵׁ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים שְׁבַ֥ע מֵא֖וֹת וְ עֶשְׂרִֽים
traditions.KJV: six thousand seven hundred and twenty asses .

69.english_reference: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work .

traditions.WLC: וּ מִ קְצָת֙ רָאשֵׁ֣י הָֽ אָב֔וֹת נָתְנ֖וּ לַ מְּלָאכָ֑ה

traditions.KJV: And some of the chief of the fathers gave unto the work .

traditions.WLC: הַ תִּרְשָׁ֜תָא נָתַ֣ן לָ אוֹצָ֗ר זָהָ֞ב דַּרְכְּמֹנִ֥ים אֶ֨לֶף֙

traditions.KJV: five hundred and thirty priests ’ garments .

traditions.KJV: and two thousand and two hundred pound of silver .

traditions.KJV: And [ that ] which the rest of the people gave [ was ]

traditions.KJV: and two thousand pound of silver ,

traditions.KJV: and threescore and seven priests ’ garments .

72.english_reference: So the priests , and the Levites , and the porters , and the singers , and [ some ] of the people , and the Nethinims , and all Israel , dwelt in their cities

traditions.WLC: וַ יֵּשְׁב֣וּ הַ כֹּהֲנִ֣ים וְ הַ לְוִיִּ֡ם וְ הַ שּׁוֹעֲרִים֩ וְ הַ מְשֹׁרְרִ֨ים וּ מִן הָ עָ֧ם וְ הַ נְּתִינִ֛ים וְ כָל יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּ עָרֵי הֶ֑ם

traditions.KJV: and when the seventh month came ,
